(updated 9-17-2026) Marsha Robinson at Lake Charles State Park (870-878-6595) said fishing success in the past week has mostly been for catfish. The bite for catfish is excellent, with anglers using worms, blood bait and cut bait. She had no reports from bass, bream or crappie. The surface water temperature has steadily been in the high 70s in the past few weeks, and on Sunday it was 78.6 degrees.
